bio: Certified HVAC technician with 8+ years of hands-on experience repairing and installing split AC units, conducting gas refills and diagnosing cooling faults. Known for punctual visits, honest advice and a tidy workspace after every job.

Focused on AC deep cleaning, preventive servicing and filter maintenance for homes and offices. I follow a strict checklist to keep indoor air clean and reduce energy waste. Quick response and guaranteed satisfaction.

Seasoned plumber experienced in water pipe installation, leakage detection and repair, bathroom fittings and drain unblocking. I use pressure tests to confirm every connection and leave the site clean and dry.

Reliable technician specializing in sink washing, washbasin and toilet unblocking, commode installation and faucet replacement. I carry professional tools and eco-safe cleaning solutions to every visit.

Licensed electrician with deep knowledge of residential wiring, circuit breaker setup, switch-socket points and safety earthing. Every job is followed by a complete load test and safety documentation.
Skilled in installing ceiling fans, LED lights, switch boards and hanging lamps with neat and concealed wiring. I balance fan blades carefully and test every switch and connection before leaving.

Expert in diagnosing automatic and semi-automatic washing machine faults covering motors, pumps, inlet valves and drainage. I replace only quality parts, explain the issue clearly and run a full test cycle.

Technician focused on fridge cooling issues, thermostat problems, compressor checks and gas charging. I always detect and seal leaks before refilling and verify temperature levels at the end of the service.
Careful with every wall type, I mount and fix LED and smart TVs with sturdy brackets, hide cables neatly and align DTH dishes for a strong signal. Channel tuning and a clean finish included.
Team leader for deep cleaning jobs covering kitchens, bathrooms and full apartments. We use safe, chemical-free solutions, follow a room-by-room checklist and always do a final quality walkthrough.
Specialist in carpet, sofa and mattress cleaning using extraction and shampoo methods with stain and odor treatment. I protect your furniture, use gentle foam and hand over dry, fresh pieces.
Experienced painting contractor handling wall putty, primer, premium paint and waterproofing. I lead a small crew, protect your floors and furniture, keep to the schedule and deliver a smooth finish.
Focused on wall crack filling, damp patch repair and seepage prevention with sealants and waterproofing coats. I diagnose the root cause first so the fix lasts, not just covers the problem.

Carpenter with strong experience in wardrobe and bed assembly, loose joint repair, broken drawer fixing and hinge alignment. I use precision tools, check stability and clean up sawdust after each job.

Detail-oriented woodworker for custom shelves, tables and kitchen cabinetry. I take exact measurements, work with quality timber and finishing varnishes, and always verify that everything fits perfectly.

Passionate gardener who designs rooftop and balcony green spaces with planters, soil work, seasonal flowers and drip watering. I choose low-maintenance plants that suit Dhaka climates and provide care guides.
I specialize in grass cutting, hedge trimming, pruning and regular plant care for home gardens. I bring my own equipment, dispose of clippings and keep your green space healthy year-round.

Experienced moving coordinator for household shifting with careful packing, loading and unpacking. I lead a trained crew, protect electronics and fragile items with secure wrapping and place furniture as requested.

Senior electrician for complex wiring, load balancing, inverter and generator connections. I prioritize safety, use proper wire gauges and provide a written completion report with tests for every installation.

Young HVAC technician offering routine AC servicing contracts for homes and small offices. I handle filter cleaning, drain flushing, thermostat checks and small parts replacement with quick turnaround times.
